# Patient.info

> Comprehensive patient health information resource providing drug interaction guides, medication safety information, and evidence-based health resources for informed healthcare decisions.

Patient.info offers detailed medication interaction guides covering common drugs like Atorvastatin, Sertraline, Citalopram, and Warfarin, alongside health assessment tools and wellness programs. The site focuses on helping patients understand drug compatibility, side effects, and safety risks when taking multiple medications or supplements.

## Key Topics

- Drug interactions
- Medication safety
- Serotonin syndrome
- Bleeding risk
- Anticoagulants
- Cholesterol medications
- Antidepressants (SSRIs)
- Supplement interactions
- Statins (Atorvastatin, Simvastatin, Rosuvastatin)
- Blood thinners (Warfarin, Rivaroxaban)
- Herbal medicines (Ashwagandha, St John's Wort)
- Drug compatibility
- Side effects monitoring
- Rhabdomyolysis risk
- QT prolongation

## Critical Drug Interactions

- [Aspirin and Methotrexate: Major Drug Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/aspirin-and-methotrexate-interaction): Aspirin-Methotrexate major interaction: toxicity & bone marrow risks
- [Sertraline and Citalopram: Can You Take Them Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/sertraline-and-citalopram-interaction): Sertraline-Citalopram major interaction: serotonin syndrome & QT risks
- [Clarithromycin and Sertraline: Can They Be Taken Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/clarithromycin-and-sertraline-interaction): Clarithromycin-Sertraline interaction: heart rhythm & serotonin risks
- [Citalopram and Co-codamol: Interaction and Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/citalopram-and-co-codamol-interaction): Citalopram-Co-codamol interaction: serotonin syndrome & pain relief risks
- [Pregabalin and Prozac: Interaction and Side Effects Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/pregabalin-and-prozac-interaction): Pregabalin-Prozac interaction: drowsiness & serotonin syndrome risks

## Cardiovascular Medication Interactions

- [Magnesium and Warfarin: Can They Be Taken Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/magnesium-and-warfarin-interaction): Magnesium-Warfarin interaction: absorption & INR stability guidance
- [Atorvastatin and Ezetimibe Interaction: Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/atorvastatin-and-ezetimibe-interaction): Atorvastatin-Ezetimibe combo: cholesterol treatment & muscle side effects
- [Atorvastatin and Rivaroxaban: Interaction Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/atorvastatin-and-rivaroxaban-interaction): Atorvastatin-Rivaroxaban minor interaction: bleeding risk guidance
- [Simvastatin and Magnesium: Interaction and Dosing Advice](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/magnesium-and-simvastatin-interaction): Simvastatin-Magnesium interaction: dose spacing for cholesterol meds
- [Atorvastatin and Alcohol: Can You Take Them Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/alcohol-and-atorvastatin-interaction): Atorvastatin-alcohol interaction: liver damage & muscle risk guidance
- [Aspirin and Quetiapine: Interaction Risks and Safety](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/aspirin-and-quetiapine-interaction): Aspirin-Quetiapine interaction: bleeding risk & dizziness guidance

## Supplement and Herbal Medicine Interactions

- [Ashwagandha and Solifenacin: Can They Be Taken Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/ashwagandha-and-solifenacin-interaction): Ashwagandha-Solifenacin interaction guide: side effects & safety risks
- [Solifenacin and St John's Wort Interaction: Reduced Efficacy](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/solifenacin-and-st-john-s-wort-interaction): Solifenacin-St John's Wort: herbal remedy reduces bladder med efficacy
- [Moringa and Progynova: Moderate Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/moringa-and-progynova-interaction): Moringa-Progynova interaction: estradiol hormone therapy effectiveness
- [Reishi and Turkey Tail: Interaction and Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/reishi-and-turkey-tail-interaction): Reishi-Turkey Tail mushroom interaction: blood clotting & immune effects
- [Can You Take Solifenacin and Vitamin D Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/solifenacin-and-vitamin-d-interaction): Solifenacin-Vitamin D compatibility: safe to take together

## Health Assessment Tools and Programs

- [Greene Menopause Scale | Menopause Symptom Assessment](https://patient.info/womens-health/greene-menopause-scale): Greene Menopause Scale: assess perimenopause & menopause symptom severity
- [10-week healthy ageing course](https://patient.info/senior-health/10-week-healthy-ageing-course): 10-week healthy ageing program: exercise, diet, brain & bone health
- [How getting older affects your sleep](https://patient.info/features/healthy-living/how-getting-older-affects-your-sleep): Aging & sleep quality: science behind elderly sleep changes & solutions
